out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: - OBSERVED: raw chicken was stored with cooked beef tender in 4-door stacked freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. - EHS educated the CFM. CFM reorganized the food items in the freezer.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: - OBSERVED: rehydrated rice noodles were stored in a big container of water at 79f.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: TPHC established for the rehydrated rice noodles.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: - OBSERVED: squeeze bottles of mango syrup, strawberry syrup, and pineapple syrup were not properly labeled.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM labeled the squeeze bottles properly.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. - OBSERVED: vegetables were stored on floor in kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS prompted the CFM to relocate the vegetables and deliveries.

out_items.name: Personal cleanliness

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: A food mployee observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM provided a cap.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of @FOOD@. - OBSERVED: a manufacturer container of red pepper was used to store black cardamom.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS educated CFM and prompted CFM to store the black cardamom in a proper container.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no cover to the refuse container in the ladies room.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS prompted CFM to provide a cover to the refuse container in the ladies room. PHO GOLDEN STAR (Inspection Date: 08/24/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided AT HANDWASHING SINK IN SERVER AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CDI: PAPER TOWELS PROVIDED DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDSINK IN SERVER AREA TO HAVE SPOONS IN IT.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: SPOONS REMOVED AND TAKEN TO DISHWASHER.

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. UPON ENTRANCE TO FACILITY, PIC WAS UNABLE TO LOCATE HIS UP TO DATE CFM CARD.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED RAW BEEF IN BAGS IN THE HANDWASHING SINK IN KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: RAW BEEF MOVED TO FREEZER. PIC RE-EDUCATED.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: WALK-IN: COOKED PORK AT 51.6F, RAW SPROUTS AT 54.2F, RICE NOODLES AT 52.3F, CHICKEN AT 44.3F. TWO-DOOR PREP-TOP: PORK AT 54.2F, CHICKEN AT 52.6F, CABBAGE AT 48.9F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: ALL TCS ITEMS RELOCATED TO FREEZERS. DO NOT STORE ANY TCS FOODS IN REFRIGERATOR UNITS UNTIL THEY ARE REPAIRED.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: BEEF AND EGG ARE ON THE MENU, AVAILABLE TO BE SERVED RAW OR UNDERCOOKED, AND NOT MARKED WITH AN ASTERISK.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. PHO GOLDEN STAR (Inspection Date: 08/05/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: OBSERVED EGG ROLLS THAWING IN TWO-DOOR PREP-TOP. UNIT WAS AT 52F AND WAS NOT HOLDING FOOD AT 41F OR BELOW.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. CDI: EGG ROLLS MOVED TO FREEZER.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found subject to contamination after receipt and during storage due to the condition as described: OBSERVED SINGLE USE GLOVES AND TO-GO BAGS INSIDE SPICE CONTAINERS WITH THE CONTAINED SPICES.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. DISPOSE OF SINGLE USE ITEMS APPROPRIATELY. DO NOT STORE SOILED ITEMS WITH FOOD ITEMS.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: WALK-IN COOLER AT 55F - HOLDING FOOD 44F-54F. TWO-DOOR PREP-TOP AT 52F - HOLDING FOOD AT 48F-54F
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CEASE USING THESE UNITS TO STORE TCS FOODS. YOU MAY NOT USE THEM UNTIL THEY HOLD FOOD AT 41F OR BELOW. COOLERS MUST BE REPAIRED WITHIN TEN DAYS OF INSPECTION DATE.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: OBSERVED DISHWASHING MACHINE READING LESS THAN 50PPM CHLORINE.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. CEASE USING THE DISHWASHING MACHINE FOR SANITIZATION AND ONLY USE THREE-VAT SINK TO SANITIZE DISHES AT 50-200PPM CHLORINE. AT TIME OF INSPECTION, PIC CALLED FOR MAINTENANCE ON THIS UNIT.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. PIC UNABLE TO PROVIDE CHLORINE TEST STRIPS.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a BLEACH test kit.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink in the front of the kitchen being used to wash equipment and the hand sink by the 3 compartment sink being used to store equipment
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EMPLOYEE REMOVED EQUIPMENT AND EHS EXPLAINED THAT HAND SINKS ARE ONLY FOR HAND WASHING.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: bean sprouts on the counter
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. EMPLOYEE ADDED LABEL.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED COOKED MEAT AND SOUP STORED ON THE FLOOR IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EMPLOYEE PLACED MEAT AND SOUP ON THE COUNTER.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed rice scoop stored in water
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC DUMPED OUT WATER.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floor behind the cook line in the kitchen is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.
